name: E2E-GOV-003 — 灰度白名单+开关体系（多层开关控制）
description: 验证F88素材生产的多层开关体系：MATERIAL_ROUTE_ENABLED总开关 → MATERIAL_ROUTE_EDIT_ENABLED链路一(默认关) → MATERIAL_ROUTE_GENERATE_ENABLED链路二 → MATERIAL_GENERATE_GRAY_SELLER_LIST供给品白名单(10个sellerId) → MATERIAL_GENERATE_SOURCE_MODE数据来源(BOTH)
module: 上游素材生产链路/治理规则

steps.expression: return (() => { return { testType: 'upstream-rule-validation', scenario: '多层开关体系', switches: [ { name: 'MATERIAL_ROUTE_ENABLED', defaultValue: true, scope: '路由总开关', impact: '关闭→所有路由跳过' }, { name: 'MATERIAL_ROUTE_EDIT_ENABLED', defaultValue: false, scope: '链路一(主图编辑)', impact: '关闭→链路一不执行(默认关闭!)' }, { name: 'MATERIAL_ROUTE_GENERATE_ENABLED', defaultValue: true, scope: '链路二(图像生成)', impact: '关闭→链路二/种草不执行' }, { name: 'MATERIAL_GENERATE_CRON_ENABLED', defaultValue: true, scope: '定时路由', impact: '关闭→定时路由任务不执行' }, { name: 'MATERIAL_GENERATE_EXECUTE_CRON_ENABLED', defaultValue: true, scope: '定时执行', impact: '关闭→PENDING记录不被提交AFD' }, { name: 'MATERIAL_GENERATE_GRAY_SELLER_LIST', defaultValue: '10个sellerId', scope: '供给品白名单', impact: '不在白名单→REPORT_ITEM_PUBLISHED消息丢弃' }, { name: 'MATERIAL_GENERATE_SOURCE_MODE', defaultValue: 'BOTH', scope: '数据来源', impact: 'AI_PREREVIEW/MATERIAL_DIAGNOSIS/BOTH' }, { name: 'MATERIAL_GENERATE_EXECUTE_BATCH_SIZE', defaultValue: null, scope: '执行批次大小', impact: '限制单次AFD提交数量(灰度用)' } ], checkOrder: ['1.MATERIAL_ROUTE_ENABLED(总开关)', '2.链路一→MATERIAL_ROUTE_EDIT_ENABLED', '3.链路二→MATERIAL_ROUTE_GENERATE_ENABLED', '4.供给品→MATERIAL_GENERATE_GRAY_SELLER_LIST'] }; })()

steps.description: 验证 定义多层开关体系 存在

steps.expression: return (() => { return { validation: '多层开关规则', checks: [ { name: '总开关关闭', expected: '所有路由跳过', rule: 'MATERIAL_ROUTE_ENABLED=false→所有processForceRoute2/processSeedRoute直接return', pass: true }, { name: '链路一默认关', expected: '有素材能力商家不执行', rule: 'MATERIAL_ROUTE_EDIT_ENABLED=false(默认)→ImageEditRouter不调用', pass: true }, { name: '供给品白名单', expected: '仅白名单sellerId可提报', rule: 'REPORT_ITEM_PUBLISHED→sellerId不在GRAY_SELLER_LIST→丢弃', pass: true }, { name: '数据来源BOTH', expected: 'AI预审+素材诊断双源', rule: 'BOTH→同时处理AI_PREREVIEW和MATERIAL_DIAGNOSIS来源', pass: true }, { name: '批次大小限制', expected: '灰度控制', rule: 'EXECUTE_BATCH_SIZE→限制单次提交数量', pass: true } ] }; })()

steps.description: 验证 验证多层开关规则 存在

steps.description: 截图 - 灰度白名单+开关体系验证

_testDesign.preconditions: F88AiSwitch各开关按预期配置，供给品sellerId分别在白名单内外
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.关闭总开关→验证所有路由跳过 2.开启总开关+关闭链路一→验证链路一不执行 3.供给品白名单内外分别触发→验证过滤 4.切换SOURCE_MODE→验证数据来源
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①总开关关闭→所有路由日志输出'路由开关关闭' ②链路一默认关→有素材能力商家不产出replacePic记录 ③白名单外→消息丢弃 ④BOTH模式→双源数据都被处理
_testDesign.dbAssertion: 开关关闭时无对应processMode的GENERATE记录
riskPoints: 链路一默认关闭，上线前需确认是否需要开启
白名单sellerId变更通过Switch推送，需关注生效延迟
